support_semantics: Outer support list is OR; each inner list is AND. A passage is covered only when every question-specific positive quote for it is fully present in returned own-block anchor windows. Scoring context never counts as support. Context-only and hard-negative quotes are not answers.
source_scope: Main-article XML title/abstract/body text and canonical tables, excluding reference/back/sub-article branches; no figure-image data or unacquired supplements. No-answer is scoped to this archived source and requested analysis.

known_source_discrepancies.description: The abstract rounds the primary adjusted SBP difference to -3.3 while the body/Table 2 reports -3.33. Table 3 reports a different change-from-baseline sensitivity estimand (-2.65), not a contradiction. Gold s1 explicitly requests Table 2.

Abstract and several table/figure-caption epoch descriptions say 29 February 2022, while the methods epoch list says 28 February 2022. The setting paragraph prints a second-wave endpoint of 31th March 2020 after October 2020. These strings remain unchanged; questions do not silently resolve these date discrepancies.

Abstract describes serologically confirmed infections whereas the body methods says laboratory-confirmed. Table 1 contains irregular printed grouping such as 26,6089 and 5,5758. The qualifying-method question uses the exact body formulation; no reformatting or derived table totals.

Training paragraph reports 38 recurrences among 307 patients as 11%; the count and percentage are retained as printed, without recomputing or using them as test-set gold. Original author fields and correction citation forms are separately retained.

alternative_support_review: Every identified sufficient alternative in archived canonical text is enumerated. Full body/abstract/table reading informed authoring; images and supplemental files were not read. Enumeration is agent-authored and may be incomplete; independent semantic review is required before freeze. No alternatives are removed based on ranks.
limits: Small agent-authored software pilot, not a clinical benchmark, evidence synthesis, treatment recommendation, or validated cross-report study retrieval.
No causal interpretation of observational associations or diagnostic utility inferred from a substring anchor.
Known correction notice concerns author citation initials only according to the notice; no latest/uncorrected or exhaustive correction/retraction audit claim.
